# Sober Bar & Kitchen

> Alcohol-free cocktails, coffee, breakfast, and lunch in downtown Gulfport, Florida. Walk-ins welcome. Open daily at 7am.

Sober Bar & Kitchen (also called Sober Bar) serves craft alcohol-free cocktails, specialty coffee, and New Orleans-inspired food. We serve non-alcoholic drinks. Some NA beers contain trace alcohol below 0.5% ABV.

## Visit

- Name: Sober Bar & Kitchen
- Address: 3062 Beach Blvd S, Gulfport, FL 33707, United States
- Phone: (813) 586-1660
- Telephone: +1-813-586-1660

- Directions: https://maps.google.com/?q=3062+Beach+Blvd+S+Gulfport+FL+33707
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/sipsoberbar
- Email: Sean@sipsoberbar.com
- Merch: https://shop.sipsoberbar.com
- Hours: Sunday–Thursday 7:00 am–10:00 pm; Friday–Saturday 7:00 am–midnight (America/New_York)
- Food: full menu from open to close (coffee, breakfast, lunch, and the evening menu). Do not invent prices or unlisted dishes.

## Dayparts

- From 7am: coffee, breakfast, and the full menu. Walk-ins are welcome.
- Daytime: coffee-house energy with free Wi-Fi. Coffee, espresso, cold brew, chai, and breakfast are covered at https://www.sipsoberbar.com/breakfast-gulfport.html (there is no separate coffee-shop URL).
- Evening: zero-proof cocktails until close (10pm Sun–Thu, midnight Fri–Sat).

## Useful answers

- We serve non-alcoholic drinks. Some NA beers contain trace alcohol below 0.5% ABV.
- The venue has approximately 50 seats: about 30 indoors and 20 on the patio. Walk-ins are welcome; reservations are available.
- It is in Gulfport, close to St. Petersburg and St. Pete Beach.
- Live jazz every Sunday brunch. Page: https://www.sipsoberbar.com/sunday-jazz-brunch.html. TODO(owner): the start time is not confirmed. Do not state a start time or a band name.
- Private events in Gulfport (showers, birthdays, office gatherings, recovery milestones, room for up to 50) are on https://www.sipsoberbar.com/private-events.html. There is no separate private-events-gulfport URL.
- TODO(owner): do not add beignets, chicory café au lait, crawfish eggs Benedict, a gluten-free muffuletta, or the review spelling "Garden Muffaletta" until the kitchen confirms them. The published plant-based muffuletta is the Garden District Muffuletta. The White Rabbit and Call Me an Ube are on the menu.
